about_the_game:
🌌 Space Cat DLC: Cats' Adventures in Space 🌌

At the edge of the universe, new adventures for kitty cats are spreading. The fascinating world of "Cats Meow Live Wallpaper" shines even brighter with a new space-themed DLC. This is the "Space Cat DLC," or the adventures of the cats in space.

This DLC is the first installment of the "Cats Meow Live Wallpaper" and takes place in a universe where endless stars greet the cats. In a world without gravity, they will find new surprises and fun. This DLC expands the cats' adventurous spirit into space, adding new stages, props, and a weightless system.

🪐 New Stages 🪐.

Asteroid Belt Around a Black Hole: The cats drift through an asteroid field deep in space. In zero gravity, they will enjoy new adventures as they play.

Inside the spaceship: More wonders await inside the spaceship. They will have fun and adventure in the nebula.

Space station in Earth's orbit: Cats will meet new friends and explore a space station floating in Earth's orbit.

Base on a Planet: New adventures await on an unknown planet. They will explore the planet's surface and find fun.

🚀 New Weightless System 🚀 With this DLC, the cats will face new challenges in outer space with the addition of the weightless system. They explore the wonders of space by walking on walls and playing inside the spaceship. New physics and animations make their space adventures more realistic and engaging.

The 🌟"Space Cat DLC" expands the world of "Cats Meow Live Wallpaper" into space, taking the cats' sense of fun and adventure to new heights. New friends, surprises, and fun await in space. With the addition of this DLC, you and your cats can take off into space and embark on new adventures! 🌟

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: core i3 6100 or later
  • Graphics: GTX1050 or Later
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Non
  • VR Support: Non
